akitaDAO.descr: the app ID of the Akita DAO

version.descr: the current version of the contract

contract.name: SubscriptionsPlugin
contract.desc:
ARC-58 plugin for the Subscriptions singleton.

Principal resolution (docs/principal-resolution/PHASE-0-SPEC.md §6.11): every target call that
resolves a principal passes `windowHint(wallet)` as its trailing hint (invariant 6, never a caller
value), and gate txns are `Gate.mustCheckFor(ctx, ...)` with exactly the context the target asserts:
`gateCtx(pluginPrincipalOf(dao, wallet))` for subscribe, `Subscriptions.triggerGateCtx(key, hint)` for
gated triggers. No plugin method changed its ABI, so grants and method restrictions carry over.

methods.name: optIn
methods.desc:
Opt the subscriptions contract (and its revenue escrow + split
recipients) into `asset`, funded by the user's wallet.

Reads `optInCost` from the subscriptions contract to size the
payment, then forwards a correctly-sized payment to
`Subscriptions.optIn`. The contract's base-class `optIn` performs
the contract's own asset opt-in and — because the subscriptions
contract has a named revenue escrow configured
(`this.akitaDAOEscrow.value.name !== ''`) — also rekeys the DAO
wallet to the revenue-manager plugin to opt the escrow and split
recipients in. That DAO-wallet rekey is on a different
AbstractedAccount instance than this plugin's rekey on the caller's
wallet, so there is no nesting conflict.

methods.name: setFeaturedService
methods.desc: setFeaturedService pays the featured box storage from the wallet on the first call only

methods.name: deposit
methods.desc: Add an arbitrary amount to a subscription owned by the wallet.

methods.name: withdraw
methods.desc: Withdraw escrowed funds from a subscription back to the wallet.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.desc: Cancel a subscription and return its escrow and MBR to the wallet.
